author: Andrea Volpato
modification: Antitone evaluates and factors the nonspatial model, uses a common wide-reference CAM16-UCS finish without separate lightness rolloff for every colour medium, calibrates print time on neutral0.18 toY0.1 through that finish, and adds a shared convex reference-negative spectral entry with calibrated neutral exposure, boundary-only radial mapping and inverse authoring DRT; coloured luminance follows the spectral reference and medium response, without photographic fitting. Spektrafilm data derivatives CC BY-SA4.0; native algorithm ports GPLv3. Historical Academy reference-derived functional coefficients rely on the source's implementation non-enforcement covenant; original notices retained in NOTICE-Academy-APD.txt.

reference_source.reference: S-2008-002 v1.1, November 18, 2010; APD and ADX gains (1, .92, .95)
reference_source.prior_and_Dmin: kodak_vision3_250d base; no negative characteristic curves
reference_source.selector: Minimum relative entropy of summed APD-action distribution at fixed flux ratios; canonical mass fixes total flux.
reference_source.receiver: TH-KG3; positive relative-filter interpolation with held endpoints, opaque outside supplied common negative support.
reference_source.scale: Canonical transmission may exceed one. Passive-filter/common-printer-exposure representation is an output-invariant gauge, not identical fixed-scale filter APD readings.
reference_source.distribution: Derived functional coefficients rely on the historical specification's implementation non-enforcement covenant; original notices retained in NOTICE-Academy-APD.txt.
